text: dsh-session-bridge 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 会话桥接插件。它在 DSH 网页服务器上注册本机桥接路由，并提供 stdio MCP 服务，让外部 MCP 客户端能查看会话、打开或复用工作区会话、发送消息、等待回合结束、读取文本回复和中断运行中的回合。适合希望从 MCP 客户端继续操作 DSH 会话的用户；需要运行兼容版本的 DSH，并配置 MCP 客户端连接。

dsh-session-bridge lets MCP clients operate DeepSeek Harness sessions. A host plugin connects the DSH web server to a stdio MCP server, which can list, open, message, wait on, read, and interrupt sessions. Use it with a compatible DSH app and MCP client.

Let my MCP client send a prompt to a running DSH session and collect its reply.
I need tools to list, reuse, and interrupt sessions in DeepSeek Harness.
dsh-session-bridge 的功能「会话发现与打开」：MCP 工具可列出会话信息，并按工作目录和预设复用最新的空闲会话；也可创建工作区和新会话。 通过对应 MCP 工具触发并返回会话结果。
dsh-session-bridge 的功能「发送消息并等待回合」：客户端可向会话发送排队或接管当前回合的消息，再按序号等待后续回合结束或超时。 通过对应 MCP 工具触发并返回会话结果。
dsh-session-bridge 的功能「读取回复与中断」：客户端可读取指定序号之后的用户提示和助手文本，并可中断正在运行的会话回合。 通过对应 MCP 工具触发并返回会话结果。

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · What is this?：DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is a desktop agent app. This package lets another agent drive it.

You get two small parts:

- **A host plugin.** It runs inside the DSH app. It serves a token-guarded loopback HTTP bridge.
- **A stdio MCP server.** Your MCP client (Claude Code, for example) starts it. It talks to the bridge.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · What is this?：Your client opens a normal DSH session, sends it messages, waits for the reply, and reads it.
The session shows in the app like any other session. You can watch it, or take it over, any time ♡

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 1. Install the plugin：Use the `dsh` CLI. Replace `default` with the name of your profile.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile default add @stellarie/dsh-session-bridge
```

Or install straight from GitHub. The install builds the package on your machine, so the profile must allow build scripts:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile default add github:stellarie/dsh-session-bridge
```

Or edit the profile by hand. Add the package to the profile `package.json`. Then list it in the bundles, after `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 2. Register the MCP server：Point your MCP client at the copy inside the profile (`<profile-dir>` is your DSH profile directory):

```bash
claude mcp add dsh-session-bridge -- node <profile-dir>/node_modules/@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge/lib/mcp.js
```

Or run it from npm, with no profile install:

```bash
claude mcp add dsh-session-bridge -- npx -y -p @stellarie/dsh-session-bridge dsh-session-bridge-mcp
```

Any other MCP client works too. The command is `dsh-session-bridge-mcp`. The transport is stdio.
@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 2. Register the MCP server：The MCP server reads the endpoint file on every call. An app restart needs no MCP restart.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `dsh_list_sessions` | List sessions: id, title, preset, working directory, running or idle. |
| `dsh_open_session` | Open a session in the Workspace of `cwd`. The app creates the Workspace when none exists. Reuses the newest idle session with the same `preset` and `cwd`. Pass `reuse: false` for a new one. A new session starts at `effort` (default `high`). |
| `dsh_send` | Send a message. Mode `queue` runs after the current turn. Mode `steer` joins the running turn. Returns `afterSeq`. |
| `dsh_wait` | Wait until the session ends a turn after `afterSeq`. Default 600 s, maximum 600 s. |
| `dsh_read` | Read your prompts and the assistant text after `afterSeq`. Tool calls and thinking are left out. |
| `dsh_cancel` | Interrupt the running turn. Queued messages stay queued. |

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · Tools：> `dsh_open_session` defaults `preset` to `yuu`, the author's own preset. Pass your own preset id.
> See [BACKLOG 1](docs/BACKLOG.md).

> A new session sets its effort through the app's model selection. The app also saves that effort as its default for every session.
> See [BACKLOG 5](docs/BACKLOG.md).

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · How the bridge stays safe (｀ω´)ゞ：The bridge gives full owner control of your sessions. Read this part, please.

Every request must pass these checks, in this order:

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · How the bridge stays safe (｀ω´)ゞ：1. No `Origin` header. Browser pages always send one, so they are refused.
2. A loopback `Host` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, or `[::1]`) with the server port.
3. A bearer token, compared in constant time.
4. `POST` only, with a JSON body of at most 1 MiB.
5. A method on the allowlist. Session methods: `create`, `prompt`, `page`, `projections`, `list`, `cancel`, `selectModel`, `modelCatalog`. Workspace method: `create`.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · How the bridge stays safe (｀ω´)ゞ：The token is 32 random bytes. The plugin mints a new one at each start.
It writes `endpoint.json` (`url`, `token`, `pid`, `startedAt`) with mode `0600` (POSIX) and deletes it on shutdown.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · How the bridge stays safe (｀ω´)ゞ：- **Treat the endpoint file as a secret.** Anyone who reads it can prompt your agents.
- The bridge listens only where the DSH web server listens. It adds no port of its own.
- The bridge speaks as the app owner. A prompt you send acts like a prompt you type in the app.
- `dsh_open_session` creates a Workspace for `cwd` when none exists, and it saves the new session's effort as the app default.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · Configuration：| Setting | Where | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `endpointPath` | plugin config in `cordis.patch.yml` | `$DSH_HOME/session-bridge/endpoint.json` |
| `DSH_SESSION_BRIDGE_ENDPOINT` | environment of the MCP server | unset |
| `DSH_HOME` | environment | `~/.dsh` |

Set the same path on both sides when you move the file.

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · Develop：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build

The build writes `lib/index.js` (the plugin) and `lib/mcp.js` (the MCP server).

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 1. 安装插件：包内附带 `cordis.patch.yml`，它会替你插入插件条目。重启应用。
日志会显示 `session-bridge: serving http://127.0.0.1:…/session-bridge`。

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 2. 注册 MCP 服务器：让 MCP 客户端指向 profile 内的副本（`<profile-dir>` 是你的 DSH profile 目录）：

```bash
claude mcp add dsh-session-bridge -- node <profile-dir>/node_modules/@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge/lib/mcp.js
```

或者直接从 npm 运行，无需安装到 profile：

```bash
claude mcp add dsh-session-bridge -- npx -y -p @stellarie/dsh-session-bridge dsh-session-bridge-mcp
```

其他 MCP 客户端也可以使用。命令是 `dsh-session-bridge-mcp`，传输方式是 stdio。

MCP 服务器每次调用都会重新读取 endpoint 文件，所以重启应用后不需要重启 MCP。

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_list_sessions` | 列出会话：id、标题、预设、工作目录、是否正在运行。 |
| `dsh_open_session` | 在 `cwd` 所在的工作区（Workspace）中打开会话；工作区不存在时由应用创建。默认复用 `preset` 和 `cwd` 相同的最新空闲会话。传 `reuse: false` 则新建。新会话以 `effort`（默认 `high`）启动。 |
| `dsh_send` | 发送消息。`queue` 模式在当前回合结束后运行，`steer` 模式加入正在运行的回合。返回 `afterSeq`。 |
| `dsh_wait` | 等待会话在 `afterSeq` 之后结束一个回合。默认 600 秒，最长 600 秒。 |
| `dsh_read` | 读取 `afterSeq` 之后你的提示和助手的文本。不含工具调用和思考内容。 |
| `dsh_cancel` | 中断正在运行的回合。已排队的消息继续保留。 |

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 工具：> 新会话通过应用的模型选择来设置 effort。应用同时会把这个 effort 保存为所有会话的默认值。
> 参见 [BACKLOG 5](docs/BACKLOG.md)。

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 桥如何保证安全 (｀ω´)ゞ：这座桥拥有对你会话的完整所有者控制权。请务必读完这一节。

每个请求都必须按顺序通过这些检查：

1. 没有 `Origin` 头。浏览器页面一定会带上它，所以会被拒绝。
2. `Host` 是回环地址（`127.0.0.1`、`localhost` 或 `[::1]`），且端口与服务器端口一致。
3. 带有持有者令牌（bearer token），并以恒定时间比较。
4. 只允许 `POST`，JSON 正文最大 1 MiB。
5. 方法在白名单内。会话方法：`create`、`prompt`、`page`、`projections`、`list`、`cancel`、`selectModel`、`modelCatalog`。工作区方法：`create`。

令牌是 32 个随机字节，插件每次启动都会重新生成。
插件在 POSIX 上以 `0600` 权限写入 `endpoint.json`（`url`、`token`、`pid`、`startedAt`），关闭时删除。

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 桥如何保证安全 (｀ω´)ゞ：- **请把 endpoint 文件当作机密。** 任何能读取它的人都可以向你的智能体发送提示。
- 桥只监听 DSH 网页服务器所监听的地址，不会自己再开端口。
- 桥以应用所有者的身份发言。你发送的提示，效果等同于你在应用里亲手输入的提示。
- `dsh_open_session` 会在 `cwd` 没有工作区时创建工作区，并把新会话的 effort 保存为应用默认值。

@stellarie/dsh-session-bridge README · 配置：| 设置 | 位置 | 默认值 |
|---|---|---|
| `endpointPath` | `cordis.patch.yml` 中的插件配置 | `$DSH_HOME/session-bridge/endpoint.json` |
| `DSH_SESSION_BRIDGE_ENDPOINT` | MCP 服务器的环境变量 | 未设置 |
| `DSH_HOME` | 环境变量 | `~/.dsh` |

移动文件时，请在两侧设置相同的路径。
